# RFC-0008: Caching rewritten

## Abstract

Replace the caching design entirely. This is only a draft, so RFC-0002 is not
yet obsolete and the spec page that includes it is not yet stale.

## Motivation

The time to live approach has not held up.

## Proposal

A new design.

## Alternatives considered

Keeping the old one.

## Backwards compatibility

Everything cached changes shape.

## Open questions

All of it.
